8414.html:
8414 *pōstikā 'skin'. [← Ir., e.g. Pers. pōst 'skin' and so ultimately of same origin as *pōstaka-]
    NiDoc. cam̄a pothi 'skin' Burrow KharDoc 107; L. pothī f. 'fleece'.
    paugaṇḍa- see *pōṅga-.
    pauṇḍra- see puṇḍra-¹.
    pautikī- see pūtī́ka-.

700.html:
700 alagna 'unconnected' MW. [Cf. aláglam 'disconnectedly, stammeringly' ŚBr.: lagna-]
    Pa. alagga- 'not joined'; K. alogᵘ 'unsuitably'; S. alag̠u, °g̠o 'separate' (-l- after lag̠o), P. alagg, Ku. alag, N. alag, °gga, A. ālag, °gā, B. ālag, ālgā, Or. alaga, °gā; H. alag, algā 'separate', argāī f. 'separation'; OMarw. alago 'separate'; G. aḷgũ 'not touching', n. 'menstruation'; M. alag 'separate', adv. 'without touching, smoothly' (with -l- after lāgṇẽ), aḷag 'properly'.
    alágla- see alagna-.
